{{Top|leg}}
The '''Communal Pool''' was located on [[Queesh]], one of the two continents on [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]]. It was a great, miry swamp pool with especially heavy vegetation. Several odd columns of plant life, arranged in a geometric pattern, marked this spot. The pool was used as a governmental ground for the [[Ergesh]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Once every month, the leaders of all the clans gathered at the Communal Pool for a continuous 40 hour meeting, in which all planetary business was conducted. Each clan leader brought one other Ergesh as an aide and ceremonial security guard.
